CustomField.description: Normalised (trimmed, single-spaced, lower-case) Plant Name, set by PlantTrigger. Unique so that "Golapa" and "golapa " cannot both exist; also the External ID used to upsert plants and link purchases/sales during data import.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically from Plant Name (trimmed, lower-case). Used to prevent duplicate plants and for data import.
CustomField.label: Plant Key
